products.title: ThinkPad Universal Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad Universal Thunderbolt 4 Dock (40B00135US) is an enterprise-grade docking station designed for a reliable and consistent video, data, and power connectivity experience in Windows-based mixed-PC environments. It allows for high-productivity setups by supporting a single 8K @ 30Hz display or up to four 4K @ 60Hz displays through a single Thunderbolt cable. Key features include lightning-fast data transfer rates up to 40 Gbps, power delivery up to 100W to charge connected laptops, and Intel vPro pass-through support for remote management. The dock is compatible with Thunderbolt 3 and 4, USB 4, and USB-C Windows-based systems.

products.title: Lenovo ThinkPad Thunderbolt 4 Workstation Dock
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad Thunderbolt 4 Workstation Dock is a high-performance connectivity hub designed to transform a laptop or desktop into a powerful workstation. Featuring a single Thunderbolt 4 host connection, it provides an extensive array of ports including Thunderbolt 4, USB-A, USB-C, Gigabit Ethernet, and a 3.5mm audio jack. It supports advanced display configurations, including a single 8K display at 30 Hz or up to four 4K displays at 60 Hz via HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4. Additionally, the dock offers up to 230W Power Delivery to keep compatible systems charged.

products.title: ThinkPad Thunderbolt 4 Workstation Dock
products.description: This Lenovo ThinkPad Thunderbolt 4 Workstation Dock offers a premium docking experience with reliable and consistent industry-leading video, data, and power connectivity. It is designed to be future-proof, enhancing productivity, efficiency, and creativity. Transform any workstation into a powerhouse by connecting a single cable to instantly add up to four 4K displays, enjoy lightning-fast 40 Gbps transfer speeds, and benefit from vPro support. The improved hardware and Dock Manager app offer a streamlined firmware updating and management experience, reducing IT management time and ensuring uninterrupted user operation.

products.title: Thinkpad Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock Gen 2
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock Gen 2 7500 is a next-generation docking station designed for business professionals and IT managers needing robust connectivity and management capabilities. It supports high-resolution video output, including up to one 8K display at 60Hz or dual 4K displays at 144Hz, leveraging 40 Gbps data speed. The dock features built-in 2.5Gbps Ethernet for fast networking and provides up to 100W Power Delivery (PD 3.1) to charge compatible laptops. It offers universal compatibility across operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) but unlocks enhanced features like MAC address passthrough on ThinkPad laptops. Furthermore, it is sustainably designed, utilizing 90% recycled post-consumer content and plastic-free packaging.

products.title: ThinkPad Thunderbolt 4 Workstation 0.7m Dock Split Cable

products.title: Thunderbolt adapter - PCIe x4 - Thunderbolt 4 x 1
products.description: The Lenovo Thunderbolt adapter is a custom x4 high-profile PCIe add-in card designed to provide high-speed connectivity and storage expansion. It features a Maple Ridge controller that powers one external and one internal Thunderbolt 4 (TBT4) port. Additionally, the card includes two mini DisplayPort inputs for graphics card integration and one mini DisplayPort for connection to an external monitor. This adapter is ideal for users seeking to expand their system's TBT4 capabilities and connectivity options.

products.title: Thinkpad Usb4 Dock
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad USB4 Dock 5000 is a high-performance docking station designed for enterprise users, delivering USB4 connectivity at speeds up to 40Gbps. It supports up to four external monitors with a maximum resolution of 3840x2160 at 60Hz via a combination of one HDMI 2.1 port, two DisplayPort 1.4 ports, and one USB-C full-function video port. The dock features a comprehensive array of ports, including front and rear USB-A and USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 ports, and Gigabit Ethernet. It provides Power Delivery of up to 65W output with a 100W input adapter and includes integrated physical security via NanoSaver and MicroSaver lock slots. Compatible with Windows 11, macOS Sonoma, and macOS Sequoia, it comes in Eclipse Black and includes a 1m USB4 cable and a 100W power adapter.

products.title: ThinkPad Thunderbolt 3 Dock Gen 2 Docking Station
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad Thunderbolt 3 Dock Gen2 is a professional-grade port replicator designed to expand the connectivity of laptops. It features a comprehensive array of ports, including two DisplayPort (DP), two HDMI, and Thunderbolt 3 interfaces, allowing for multiple monitor setups. It also includes several USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-A ports, a Gigabit Ethernet (1GbE) RJ-45 port for stable networking, and a 3.5mm audio combo jack. The dock is powered by a 135W adapter and is compatible with Lenovo ThinkPad notebooks as well as other brands like HP, Dell, and Apple that support USB-C Alt-Mode or Thunderbolt protocols.

products.title: ThinkPad Hybrid USB Type-C Laptop Dock with USB Type-A Adapter
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkPad Hybrid USB-C with USB-A Dock (model 40AF0135US) is an enterprise-class universal docking station designed for professional productivity. It supports ThinkPad RapidCharge and is compatible with both older Lenovo and non-Lenovo laptops. This docking station allows for expanded connectivity, supporting up to dual UHD 4K displays via DisplayPort and HDMI ports. It features high-speed data transfer with three USB 3.1 Gen 2 ports (up to 10Gbps), two USB 2.0 ports, and a USB-C port. Additional connectivity includes a Gigabit Ethernet port and a stereo/mic combo audio jack. The unit delivers 130W pass-through power delivery to keep your laptop charged while connected.
